title: Trilobytes Extensions: Galv's Extra Agility Turn

posts.author: Trihan
posts.body:
Galv Extra Agility Turn Extended v1.00
Trilobytes by Trihan
Introduction
This plugin was written to address a forum request. Galv's Extra Agility Turns has many useful features, but doesn't currently support the ability to only award extra turns to actors, enemies, or on an individual basis. It also limits you to one extra turn.
Features
- Adds individual parameters to enable extra turns for only actors or enemies
- Adds a notetag to enable extra turns for specific actors or enemies
- Allows multiple extra turns to be added, with their own threshold percentages
